caption: Three myths about AI agents in business, and what actually works when you put one to work.

slides.say: Everyone is shipping AI agents right now. Here are three myths I keep hearing from business owners.
Reality: agents need clear limits. Decide what they can do alone, and what needs a human yes.
Reality: one agent on one painful workflow beats ten agents on nothing. Start narrow.

slides.screen: 3. The model is the hard part
slides.say: Reality: the hard part is your data and your process. A messy process, automated, is still messy.
Pick one boring, repeated task. Measure it before and after. Then expand. Follow for more.
